description: Post moderation: any moderation-service response other than 429 (a 5xx or an auth error body) parses to flagged undefined and is treated as approved, so posts publish unmoderated.
notes: FM-02 (unknown outcome of external calls). isFlagged() special-cases only 429. Any other non-2xx response (a 500/503 or 401 with a JSON error body such as {"error": "..."}) parses fine, `verdict.flagged` is undefined, and the function returns false: an unknown outcome treated as "approved", so posts are published unmoderated whenever the service is degraded or misconfigured. Severity important: FM-02 is important, and critical only on money or inventory paths. Fix: check response.ok and fail closed (throw) on any other status, and validate the body (flagged must be a boolean). The timeout, env wiring and router change are legitimate.
